signin.title: Claude UsageChecker - Sign in
signin.heading: Own sign-in
signin.intro: This gives the application its own access rights, so it no longer depends on reading the token of a running Claude Code installation. The only right requested is to read your usage (user:profile).
signin.step1: 1. Open the page and grant access
signin.urlHint: Opens claude.ai. If the browser does not open, the address can be copied here.
signin.unavailable: Signing in is not available in this view.

signin.pasteCode: Please paste the code from the Anthropic page.

install.title: Set up Claude UsageChecker
install.heading: Set up permanently?
install.intro: The application is currently running from where you downloaded it. But autostart and the pinned tray icon both depend on its location – if that folder is cleaned out, you lose them.
install.listIntro: If you agree, it will be:
install.outro: The downloaded file stays where it is and can be deleted. Both can be changed in the settings at any time.
install.languageHint: Applied when you continue – whichever of the two buttons you choose.
about.title: About Claude UsageChecker
about.description: Shows the session and weekly limits of a Claude subscription in the system tray. Reads usage figures through its own sign-in and writes nothing back.
